name: Togglecraft for WooCommerce
author: rutvap

sections.description:
Togglecraft for WooCommerce makes it easy to customize your store without writing code.

Instead of editing theme files or using complex hooks, you can control key WooCommerce elements directly from a simple admin interface.

Add content, rename labels, and manage visibility across product, cart, and checkout pages in just a few clicks.

Perfect for store owners, freelancers, and developers who want faster customization without complexity.

Features

  • Add custom content before/after Add to Cart button
  • Insert content on cart and checkout pages
  • Rename labels like “Billing Details”, “Place Order”, and “Add to Cart”
  • Customize Add to Cart button text on product and shop pages
  • Shortcode support for flexible placement
  • Show or hide elements like coupon field and order notes
  • Simple toggle-based UI for easy control
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
  3. Go to the “Togglecraft” menu in the admin panel
  4. Configure settings as needed
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all themes?

It works with most WooCommerce-compatible themes. Some features depend on theme structure.

Does it support WooCommerce block checkout?

Currently optimized for classic WooCommerce checkout.

Can I use this with page builders like Elementor?

Yes, shortcode support allows compatibility with page builders.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No, all features are accessible through a simple admin interface.
